decontamination.visual: Drop every library image whose MUSK image cosine to any available PathMMU image (all splits) is >= visual_threshold.
decontamination.text: Drop every library record whose caption shares a normalized word 10-gram with any PathMMU question, option, answer or explanation (all splits).
decontamination.source: Drop every library image whose source (YouTube video, PubMed figure without subfigure suffix, tweet, TCGA patient) contains an image with MUSK cosine >= source_threshold to any PathMMU image (such pairs were visually identical slides).
